sources.articleTitle: One person taken to hospital after ‘unknown substance’ sparks concert evacuation
Manchester Co-op Live evacuation: ‘Unknown substance’ sparks Don Toliver concert chaos ahead of London gigs
Don Toliver concert in Manchester evacuated after unknown substance released, police say

headline: Don Toliver Concert Evacuated At Manchester Co-op Live Arena
metaDescription: More than 12,000 attendees were evacuated from Don Toliver's performance at Manchester's Co-op Live arena following the release of an unknown substance.
aiSummaryBullets: More than 12,000 fans were safely evacuated from a Don Toliver concert in Manchester.
Police reported an unknown substance was released, causing eye and breathing issues for attendees.
At least one individual was transported to a hospital following the incident at the Co-op Live arena.
aiContextParagraph: A performance by rapper Don Toliver at the Co-op Live arena in Manchester was abruptly halted on November 23, 2026, leading to a mass evacuation of the venue. According to police reports, upwards of 12,000 concertgoers were cleared from the site after an unidentified substance was released into the air. The incident resulted in several attendees reporting immediate physical reactions, including respiratory distress and eye irritation. Emergency services were deployed to the scene to assist those affected, and local authorities confirmed that at least one person required hospital treatment. While the exact nature of the substance remains under investigation, the evacuation proceeded without further reported complications for the crowd. This event occurred shortly before the artist was scheduled to perform upcoming shows in London, though the status of those future tour dates remains to be confirmed by organizers following this security incident.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to reports across two independent media outlets and a moderate viral activity score reflecting significant public interest in the large-scale evacuation.
